title: Adapted Physical Activity for Children Treated With Cancer and Insulin Sensitivity
official: Adapted Physical Activity for Children Treated With Cancer and Insulin Sensitivity
summary: The main objective of this study is to evaluate the evolution of the sensitivity to insulin, a hormone that acts on sugar in the body, as well as other metabolic, motor and nutritional elements of children with cancer, according to the practice of intense physical activities or stretching. In view of the scientific work on this subject, it is expect to observe that the practice of intense physical activities will improve the results of the children in the metabolic, motor and nutritional evaluations, compared to the stretching program.
